messages:
alex: Opening a small docs PR to sync SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries across py/ts/go. Will update quickstart and migration guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4271

maria: Thanks. Key mapping we discussed: `page_token` -> `cursor_token`, response `next_cursor` replaces `cursor`, and `retry_policy` -> `retries`. Please add a short migration note showing field mapping.

jordan: For streaming, sample shapes changed: Python now exposes an async iterator (`async for t in client.stream.generate(...)`), TS `for await (const t of client.stream.generate(...))`, Go uses `for { tok, err := stream.Next(ctx); if err == io.EOF { break } ... }`. Include minimal error handling.

sam: I'll push a lightweight Go snippet that shows `defer stream.Close()` and `if err == io.EOF { break }` handling. Also update TS to call out idempotency when using cursors + retries.

maria: Python snippet I propose (compact for quickstart):

```python
try:
    async for chunk in client.stream.generate(model="rwd-1-stream", prompt=prompt, retries={"attempts": 2}):
        sys.stdout.write(chunk.text)
except StreamError as e:
    logger.error("stream failed", exc_info=e)
    # fallback: client.sync.generate(...)
```

maria: Add a one-liner about partial token yields and buffering if users need sentence boundaries.

alex: Good. CI caught a broken link in examples/pagination-old.md (404). ci-bot: see details.

ci-bot: build/docs: linkcheck failed on `examples/pagination-old.md` -> 404. CI job: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1298

sam: I fixed the link in the branch to point to `examples/pagination-migration.md` and re-ran linkcheck.

jordan: I'll leave a review with a couple wording tweaks and ask that sample code remain <=8 lines in quickstart, link to full examples for error/batching.

alex: Assigning reviewers @maria and @jordan. Merge once +2 and green CI. Thanks all :thumbsup:
